selection: Production hardening commits after the last June feature wave and before the ratified campaign plans.

fixes.subject: Fix live counter rebuild from HEAD
fixes.risk_preserved: Startup counters must describe the selected live tree even when stable root path keys are stale.

fixes.subject: Harden B-tree walks and repair reporting
fixes.risk_preserved: A damaged child must be reported; best-effort listing may continue but must not become a complete authoritative traversal.

fixes.subject: Improve B-tree repair and GC mark safety
fixes.risk_preserved: GC must fail closed on incomplete live-tree traversal and targeted repair must preserve non-file children.

fixes.subject: Harden GC and evict clean index cache
fixes.risk_preserved: GC rechecks concurrent writes and index eviction only drops clean, reconstructible state.

fixes.subject: Reduce commit latency under large indexes
fixes.risk_preserved: Metadata index mutation stays in the shared write buffer and does not synchronously flush during blob commit.

fixes.subject: Queue blob commit backpressure
fixes.risk_preserved: Distinct commits queue behind one worker instead of receiving a saturation 429, while a concurrently duplicated manifest is rejected as retryable.

fixes.subject: Constrain GC hard-link dereferencing
fixes.risk_preserved: GC must interpret hash-sized payloads as hard links only for DirectoryIndex entries; a valid typed record whose serialized length equals the hash length must remain a typed payload.
